comment.body:
Thanks for including the crash stack — it already points to a PowerLauncher Desktop-composition failure. To tell whether this is still a current bug and which launcher path is involved, please provide:

1. Whether the same crash still reproduces on the latest stable PowerToys build.
2. A fresh diagnostic ZIP by reproducing the crash and then posting a comment with /bugreport immediately afterward. If PowerToys will not reopen, please run BugReportTool.exe from the PowerToys installation folder instead.
3. What PowerToys surface was visible just before it crashed (for example Run, Settings, or a theme/display transition).

That will separate an old crash signature from a still-current launcher regression.
